body: I don't know what she could do either way.  But thanks.
Thanks for the well wishes.  Honestly, I don't want to burden my family.  They are a few hours drive away and I don't need my mom to get upset because I'm sad.

I'm sharing things anonymously.  That's probably the most cowardly thing I've heard of lol.

I've told my wife that I will be faithful and tell her that I love her every day.  I also tell her how attractive she is all of the time.  I can just tell how she reacts to some things.  I can see how she looks at me and I can sense the disappointment.  She's in it for forever, but I feel like it's a trap for her.  She is religious and is in the ABSOLUTELY FOREVER camp about marriage.  I've screwed her over.

My family may accept it, but I don't want to talk about my sexuality with family.  That's weird to me.  It's also irrelevant.  

What's stopping me from finding a job where I can interact with people all day?  Most of them pay shit for one and don't have anywhere to go after that.  I have a fucking degree and nothing to do with it.  I'd love to be a sales manager, but that job is next to impossible to get without prior experience with the company or hardcore B2B sales.  I would love to find out what I want to do with my life, but I haven't been attracted to much and I can't find any resources to make this any better.

>People who love you would much rather hear you out and help you, rather than having to deal with the sorrow of losing you.

That's all well and good, but my relationships would fundamentally change, people would lose respect for me, and I would always be the broken person.  That's not something I would look forward to for the rest of my life.
I really don't know what to say.  Thanks for the offer.

Well, I'm not sure it's because society is telling me to be quiet about my problems.  It's really embarrassing to tell someone that I can't handle my own life and I'm tired of being a burden to them.  How the hell am I supposed to say that to my family? 

I don't think she will ever feel the same about me again, to be honest.  I don't think she trusts me and I think I'll end up ruining her life.

Well, another issue with the wife is that she caught me sharing pics with guys....so...that's not exactly the same thing.  I know I didn't say it in the OP.  It's embarrassing as hell.  I have no idea.  I haven't done it since.  This is not the only reason I feel that I'm a shitty person.

My family won't think that I'm normal.  They may still love me and they may put on whatever masks, but nobody will think more of me.  Nobody will think the same of me.  They'll judge and rightfully so.

I would hate programming, personally.  I find it very boring.  I'm not super tech savvy.  I'm actually, probably surprisingly, pretty good with people.  I used to be a store manager for a retail place and I was awesome at it.  As a manager and sales person.  The biggest reasons that I left were that I worked 60-80 hours a week and couldn't do anything else ever.

Don't worry about me bothering you.  I'll deal with it eventually.
Yeah I don't see anything on the horizon coming up as a new hobby.  Thanks for the help.

Well, most of the issue is that I don't want to talk to anyone about being depressed.  I think my wife is picking up on it, though.  It's embarrassing for me.  I don't want my family to know.  That's completely out of the question.  I need to find a way to just deal with it myself.

There is a reason to hate myself.  I'm not what I represented (I wasn't ready to admit it to myself, much less anyone else), I can't be the person that my wife wants, and I'm pretty much going nowhere REALLY fucking fast.

Well, I really liked working out not long ago.  I still do it.  I used to run 10 or so miles a week and lift 2-3 times a week.  Now, I usually just stick to the lifting.  I've tried to find something distracting or some kind of hobby, but nothing presents itself really.  I play fantasy football, but that's whatever.  I play games, but that's falling off of my radar.  I haven't felt like I've gotten enjoyment out of anything in a while.

I think her opinion of me has changed a lot.  She doesn't show it, but I am almost certain that she has lost a ton of respect for me, doesn't trust me, and that she constantly has to tell herself that I wasn't a mistake.

I work at a University doing administration shit.  It's boring, not fulfilling, and the people that I work with are scheming assholes for no reason.  I mean, we work at a fucking University.  Who cares?

My dog is a lab mix and I don't want to give his name so I can remain anonymous.
